evaluation.limitations: Only original static standalone content and explicitly linked images are restored. Archive solution navigation, shared sheep/status requests and scripts are removed; round-return navigation and the artwork-credit hyperlink are inert, with attribution wording retained. Original geometry, blank cells, symbols, letter case, repeated clues and historical wording remain unchanged. Four broken Bootstrap font paths are corrected to the existing same-year publisher files; original source bytes and the four 404 responses are retained privately. Source-named Google font binaries are current snapshots with their OFL texts, not certified historical font versions. Local system font fallbacks are not bundled. Gold, total points, splits, license and grading/runtime readiness are unchanged and not recertified. The stylesheet also points its unused archive-logo rule at a missing path; the original logo survives in the same-year spoilr/images directory and is preserved locally, without restoring archive navigation. Multiple-choice alternatives and their letter tags remain in original order; game spoilers in question wording are not treated as benchmark-answer disclosure. Prior limitations: The answer key exists, but the contestant puzzle page has not been separated from embedded answers and media dependencies.
